verdict.rationale: LanceDB's core library is Apache-2.0 licensed and open source, meaning developers can prototype fully for free without a paywall (lancedb-github-license-1). However, there is no evidence in the pack describing a specific hosted/cloud pricing plan with a defined 'free tier' (usage limits, quotas, upgrade path) versus paid tiers. Missing for 10: explicit cloud pricing page details, free-tier quota/limits documentation, evidence of a paid plan structure to compare against.
